input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, stipulated sums or early-termination/minimum fees are payable by Clear Capital anywhere in the Agreement. Section 3 (compensation) provides only for time-and-materials fees, reimbursable expenses and taxes, with no late-payment penalty or interest; Sections 6(a)/(b) and the duplicate 7(c) termination provision entitle RadialSpark only to fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the termination date, which is compensatory rather than a liquidated amount. Section 7 contains only mutual liability caps and a consequential-damages waiver, and searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "minimum" and "interest" return no Customer-payable stipulated sums. As a direction rule, nothing runs against us, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties) is already met and no redline is needed.
